- **A run that cannot take its lock writes no log at all.** A run without its lock would leave the one log retention is allowed to delete — an active log with no lock cannot be told from a crashed run's, so retention could delete it under the writer that still holds it. A run whose lock cannot be created now warns once, naming the lock and the real cause, and runs unlogged — no log file exists for it. (`test/shell/run-log-projection.test.ts`)
